scope: Secondary post hoc F2a diagnostics on the original frozen predictions; not a prospective preregistration
source_read: Existing cache and saved prediction/calibration/epoch artifacts only
export_persistence: GitHub; separate derived-input run, no raw OHLCV or weights

diagnostics.residual_definition: observed target minus original saved forecast, per individual predictor
diagnostics.stability_test: Calendar-quarter indicator joint Wald test on daily mean of individual-seed squared errors; HAC14

multiplicity.scope: One separate exploratory family; no alteration of primary benchmark Holm decisions
multiplicity.undefined_tests: null p-value with reason; conservative inclusion in family size

uncertainty.calibration_to_test_gap: Separate-calendar moving-block descriptive comparison, not paired-date inference

limitations: Classical residual p-values are approximate and require their assumptions; Holm does not validate assumptions
Seeds are optimization trajectories, not independent markets
No predictive CDF exists, so PIT remains non-estimable
No predeclared delta_g exists for the active protocol; no confirmatory absence-of-overfit claim
HPO learning curves reflect selection and do not independently validate final predictors
No per-date training predictions are available under the no-reinference restriction
